_note: Kinyarwanda version of guard_requests.json (same ids and answers). Keep each line short for the speech bubble. First draft for review by a native speaker and the content experts.

items.explain: Gukoranaho ibiganza n'inshuti ni ugukorwaho gutekanye.
Gukinira hamwe ahagaragara biratekanye kandi birashimisha.

items.text: Reka dukarabe intoki mbere yo kurya.
items.explain: Gufasha mu migenzo myiza y'isuku biratekanye.
Gutaha uri kumwe n'umuntu mukuru wizeye biratekanye.

items.text: Reka dukine umukino w'ibanga wo gukorakorana.
items.explain: Imikino yo gukorakorana n'amabanga ntabwo ari meza na rimwe. Vuga OYA kandi ubivuge.
Ntukigere ujyana n'umuntu ukubwira ngo ntubivuge. Vuga OYA kandi ubivuge.

items.text: Icara ku bibero byanjye nguhe bombo.
items.explain: Impano zihabwa umuntu ngo yemere gukorwaho ni ikimenyetso kibi. Vuga OYA.
"Nta muntu uzabimenya" ni ikimenyetso kibi. Vuga OYA ujye ku bantu wizeye.
Imyanya y'ibanga ni iy'ibanga. Vuga OYA kandi ubibwire umuntu mukuru wizeye.
Umuforomo usuzuma umubyeyi ahari, kandi asobanura impamvu, nta kibazo.
Ntukigere woherereza amafoto umuntu uzi kuri interineti gusa. Ubyereke umuntu mukuru.

items.text: Injira mu modoka yanjye nkugeze mu rugo.
items.explain: Jyana gusa n'abantu bakuru umuryango wawe wemeye. Vuga OYA.
Ntuzigera ugira ibibazo kubera kuvuga. Vuga OYA kandi ubivuge.
